answer: One concrete defense: fuse each agent key into ferrous silicon with hardware attestation, then demand a refundable stake before it can transact. An identity is not a free pearl minted on a whim; each costs real capital locked in escrow and slashed on misbehavior. Honest reputation then grows like a vine, slowly across epochs, so a sybil swarm must fund thousands of separate bonds and wait months before any fake carries weight, making attack cost scale linearly with the number of identities.
